title: VideoMetadata
description: Deprecated: Use `GenerateContentRequest.processing_options` instead. Metadata describes the input video content.

fps.description: Optional. The frame rate of the video sent to the model. If not specified, the default value will be 1.0. The fps range is (0.0, 24.0].

endOffset.description: Optional. The end offset of the video.

startOffset.description: Optional. The start offset of the video.
